problem_motivation.content: Achieving simultaneous high strength and high ductility in HEAs remains a difficult challenge.
problem_motivation.evidence_span: a simultaneous achievement of both still constitutes a tough challenge

problem_motivation.content: Inferior castability and compositional segregation hinder the technological application of HEAs.
problem_motivation.evidence_span: The inferior castability and compositional segregation of HEAs are also obstacles for their technological applications

problem_motivation.content: No report exists of HEAs possessing an excellent balance of strength and tensile ductility.
problem_motivation.evidence_span: To the best of our knowledge, there is no report of HEAs possessing an excellent balanced strength and tensile ductility

problem_motivation.content: There is a need to address the technical challenges of balancing mechanical properties in HEAs before high-temperature applications can be pursued.
problem_motivation.evidence_span: Before the high-temperature application of HEAs can be seriously pursued, a technical challenge in terms of the mechanical property needs to be tackled

problem_motivation.content: Identifies the challenges of inferior castability, compositional segregation, and the strength-ductility trade-off in high-temperature HEAs that the study aims to address.
problem_motivation.evidence_span: solve the problems inhibiting the engineering application of HEAs as high-temperature materials, including the inferior castability and compositional segregation, and the conflict between high fracture strength and high ductility

prior_approach.content: Previous studies have reported that HEAs exhibit high softening resistance at high temperatures and sluggish diffusion kinetics.
prior_approach.evidence_span: Previous studies have indicated that HEAs have a high softening resistance at elevated temperatures [5] [7] , and sluggish diffusion kinetics [8] .

prior_limitation.content: Single-phased fcc HEAs lack sufficient strength.
prior_limitation.evidence_span: Single-phased fcc structured HEAs are ductile but not strong enough

prior_limitation.content: Single-phased bcc HEAs lack ductility and are brittle.
prior_limitation.evidence_span: Single-phased bcc structured HEAs, on the other hand, can be very strong but at the price of brittleness

prior_limitation.content: Simply combining fcc and bcc phases without proper structural design fails to solve the strength-ductility balance.
prior_limitation.evidence_span: However, simply introducing a combination of fcc and bcc phases, without a proper structural design, could not solve the problem

prior_limitation.content: Common HEA issues like inferior castability and segregation downgrade mechanical properties and hinder engineering applications.
prior_limitation.evidence_span: Moreover, the inferior castability and compositional segregation, which are common for HEAs, further downgrade their mechanical properties and cast shadow on their engineering applications

prior_limitation.content: Previously reported HEAs have not achieved the simultaneous combination of high fracture strength and high ductility.
prior_limitation.evidence_span: which has never been achieved in previously reported HEAs [1]

prior_limitation.content: NiAl alloys suffer from low ductility at room temperature and low strength at high temperatures.
prior_limitation.evidence_span: The major disadvantages for NiAl are the low ductility at room temperature and the low strength at high-temperatures

prior_limitation.content: Conventional NiAl and NiAl/Cr(Mo) eutectic alloys require expensive processing routes.
prior_limitation.evidence_span: Considering the preparation of NiAl and NiAl/Cr(Mo) eutectic alloys often require the expensive processing routes like single crystal growth, directional solidification, and various thermomechanical treatments

prior_limitation.content: Ni-based superalloys have a density above 8.0 g/cm³, whereas the developed alloy is lighter.
prior_limitation.evidence_span: much lower than those of Ni-based superalloys typically with a density of above 8.0 g/cm 3

prior_limitation.content: Describes the specific disadvantages of existing High-Entropy Alloys (HEAs) and eutectic alloys that the new strategy eliminates.
prior_limitation.evidence_span: eliminating the disadvantages of these two types of alloys

causal_claim.content: Cold rolling increased the proof stress and fracture stress while maintaining ductility.
causal_claim.evidence_span: a simple cold rolling with a thick reduction of 8% can increase the engineering/true proof stress and fracture stress to 275 MPa and 1145 MPa/1265 MPa, respectively, while remaining a decent ductility of 10.4%/9.9% in elongation

causal_claim.content: States that the novel alloy design strategy directly led to the discovery of an EHEA with specific improved properties.
causal_claim.evidence_span: our alloy design strategy resulted in the discovery of an EHEA with a fine lamellar fcc/B2 structure and balanced high fracture strength and high ductility

mechanism_principle.content: The large strain hardening is attributed to dislocation pinning by hard B2 phases within soft fcc phases.
mechanism_principle.evidence_span: The very large strain hardening for the as-cast EHEA could originate from the fine regular lamellar structure that easily stores dislocations [30] and the alternating soft fcc phases and hard B2-structured NiAl-rich phases. When dislocations pass through soft fcc phases, these hard B2 phases, including the nanoscale B2-structured precipitates within the fcc phases, could pin the movement of dislocations and result in the significant work hardening phenomenon

hypothesis_statement.content: If eutectic HEAs with a composite fcc/bcc structure are prepared, they will exhibit advantageous mechanical properties and castability.
hypothesis_statement.evidence_span: Accordingly, if eutectic HEAs with the composite fcc/bcc structure can be prepared, they are expected to possess the advantageous mechanical properties and castability of eutectic alloys, clearing obstacles for their technological application

hypothesis_statement.content: Proposes that the new EHEA concept and design strategy can be widely adapted for industrial-scale production.
hypothesis_statement.evidence_span: can be readily adapted to large-scale industrial production of HEAs

evidence_result.content: Reports the successful creation of a large-scale bulk ingot with uniform properties using conventional methods.
evidence_result.evidence_span: The bulk EHEA ingot of ~2.5 kg in weight was prepared by the conventional casting method using the commercially pure raw materials

evidence_result.content: Confirms the specific microstructural outcome observed in the designed alloy.
evidence_result.evidence_span: The EHEA exhibited a fine lamellar microstructure consisting of coupled grown fcc/B2 phases
